name: catalog_fields
description: One field of a catalog's schema: a stable identifier, a label that may change, a type that never changes, and type settings.
lifecycle: Saved as part of the whole ordered field list. Archiving keeps the values and hides the field from editing. Deleted at runtime only while no record, override or promotion holds a value for it, and with its catalog.

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated stable field UUID; record values are keyed by it.
Company that owns the catalog (tenant key).
Catalog whose schema holds the field; immutable.
Zero-based order in the schema, 0 to 59, unique within the catalog by the module.
Display label chosen by members, trimmed, 1 to 80 characters; renaming never changes meaning.
TEXT, LONG_TEXT, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, DATE, TIME, WEEKDAYS, SELECTION, MONEY, MEDIA or REFERENCE; immutable.
Whether every record must hold a value; never true for MONEY fields.
Validated type settings: maximum length, decimal places and bounds, selection choices with stable identifiers, or whether promotions are allowed.
ISO 4217 alphabetic code of a MONEY field; immutable (ADR-0032).
columns.Null meaning: The field is not a MONEY field.

columns.Meaning: Catalog whose records a REFERENCE field points to; immutable.
columns.Null meaning: The field is not a REFERENCE field.

columns.Meaning: PostgreSQL-clock instant the field was archived.
PostgreSQL-clock instant the field was added.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, catalog_id) REFERENCES catalogs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: A field belongs to a catalog of the same company and is deleted with it.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, target_catalog_id) REFERENCES catalogs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A reference target is a catalog of the same company that cannot be deleted while targeted.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((type = 'MONEY'::"CatalogFieldType") = (currency IS NOT NULL)) AND ((currency IS NULL) OR (currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text))))
constraints.Purpose: MONEY fields, and only they, carry a three-letter uppercase currency code.
Labels are trimmed and not empty.
MONEY fields are never required, because prices are saved separately.
A schema has at most 60 positions.
REFERENCE fields, and only they, carry a target catalog.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX catalog_fields_catalog_position_idx ON public.catalog_fields USING btree (company_id, catalog_id, "position")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_fields_company_id_id_key ON public.catalog_fields USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key that prices and record links reference.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX catalog_fields_target_idx ON public.catalog_fields USING btree (company_id, target_catalog_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds the reference fields that target a catalog.
